description: Fetches the Midvash commentary for the chapter a reference points to — what the chapter is about, its context and its main movements. Every one of the 1,189 Bible chapters has one, in 9 languages. Use this for "what is this chapter about" questions. For the text itself, use get_passage. Returns a summary with a link to the full commentary.

language.description: Optional language for the commentary: en, pt-br, es, fr, de, it, zh, ru, ko. Defaults to the connection language, or English.

reference.description: Any Bible reference inside the chapter you want commentary on. "John 3", "João 3:16" and "Romans 8:1-11" all resolve to that chapter.

name: get_commentary
